description: A Python script implementing an AI-powered conversational bot that integrates speech recognition, text-to-speech, large language models, and real-time messaging pipelines. It sets up a processing pipeline with multiple components, including voice activity detection, language processing, and output handling, with specific configurations and event handlers.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Represents the conversational context for the language model, managing message history.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pairs user and assistant context aggregators for managing conversation state.

classes.name: LLMUserAggregatorParams
classes.description: Parameters configuring user-side aggregation of language model interactions.

classes.name: RTVIConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for RTVI real-time video interface processing.

classes.name: RTVIObserver
classes.description: Observer class for RTVI processing to monitor and react to pipeline events.

classes.name: RTVIProcessor
classes.description: Core processor class for RTVI real-time video interface handling.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Represents the sequence of processing steps for the AI conversation pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Parameters controlling pipeline behavior such as metrics and usage tracking.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Defines a task combining a pipeline, its parameters, observers, and execution context.

classes.name: RunnerArguments
classes.description: Arguments passed into the runner to configure execution behavior.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Asynchronous function that initializes services, constructs the processing pipeline, and runs the chat bot.

methods.description: Main entry point to start the bot using the provided runner arguments.

methods.description: Execution entry point from the script's main guard, invoking the main runner.
